fine_lines.title: exciting vs excited
fine_lines.explanation_ar: exciting تصف الشيء (خبر مثير)، و excited تصف شعور الشخص (أنا متحمّس).
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Exciting" describes the thing. "Excited" describes how a person feels.

examples.sentence: I'm excited about my new job.

fine_lines.title: I just got vs I get
fine_lines.explanation_ar: I just got تعني حصلت للتوّ (منذ وقت قصير). I get tired تعني أصبح متعبًا (عادة).
fine_lines.explanation_en: "I just got" = a very short time ago. "I get tired" = I become tired (habit).

examples.sentence: I just got a new job.
I get tired after long days.

expressions.phrase: You look really happy today. What's up?
expressions.meaning_ar: تبدو سعيدًا جدًا اليوم. ما الأمر؟
expressions.meaning_en: Notice someone's mood and ask why.
expressions.example: You look really happy today. What's up?

expressions.phrase: I just got a new job.
expressions.example: Guess what? I just got a new job!
You're going to Japan? Wow, that's exciting!
What is your favorite book? I like adventure stories.

expressions.phrase: Do you come to this coffee shop often?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل تأتي إلى هذا المقهى كثيرًا؟
expressions.example: Do you come here often? Every Saturday.

expressions.phrase: Do you want to sit together? — Yes, I would like that!
expressions.meaning_ar: هل تريد أن نجلس معًا؟ — نعم، يسعدني ذلك!
expressions.meaning_en: Invite someone to sit with you.
expressions.example: Do you want to sit together? Yes, I would like that!

expressions.phrase: How do you relax after work?
expressions.example: How do you relax after work? I read books.

expressions.phrase: Maybe we can go to the gym together one day.
expressions.meaning_ar: ربما يمكننا الذهاب إلى الصالة الرياضية معًا يومًا ما.
expressions.example: Maybe we can go to the park together one day.

grammar.title: Future with will: What will you do?
grammar.explanation_ar: نسأل عن المستقبل بـ What will you do? ونجيب: I will work in a bookstore. وأيضًا يمكن استخدام المضارع البسيط لموعد ثابت: I start next week.
grammar.explanation_en: Use will for the future. The present simple can show a fixed start time: I start next week.
examples: I will work in a bookstore.

grammar.title: Present simple for habits + frequency
grammar.explanation_ar: المضارع البسيط مع كلمات التكرار: I come here every Saturday. Sometimes the work hours are too long.
grammar.explanation_en: Present simple with every Saturday, sometimes, often.
examples: Do you come to this coffee shop often?

grammar.title: help + someone + verb
grammar.explanation_ar: help + شخص + الفعل في أصله: It helps me feel good.

questions.explanation_ar: I would like that = يسعدني ذلك.

questions.question: Sometimes the work hours are too long. I get ___.
How's work ___? — It is okay.
questions.explanation_ar: How's work going? كيف يسير العمل؟
